name: Batches
description: One row per trade show attended

agentPrompts.label: Start a new trade show batch
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-expo-leads` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then create a new batch for the trade show I name, with its location and start/end dates, so leads captured there can be linked to it.

agentPrompts.label: Which shows am I tracking?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-expo-leads` skill in this folder, then list the trade show batches on record with their dates and location, most recent first.
